specific_objectives: 23.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the construction and requirements of typical aircraft fuel system and its components.

intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft fuel system?
Name two common methods used to deliver fuel to the engine.
Why is fuel system reliability critical for flight safety?

Describe the purpose of the fuel strainer in the system.
